correctness.rationale: For C_n^2 the shortest path distance is ceil(min(k,n-k)/2)=(delta(k)+delta(k) mod 2)/2. Discrete Fourier diagonalization of the circulant distance matrix yields an explicit nonconstant spectrum. For even n, the parity term contributes a single alternating frequency and every nonconstant eigenvalue is nonpositive. For odd n=2N+1, the parity Dirichlet sum yields lambda_j=-1/4(1/(1+(-1)^j cos(pi j/n))+(-1)^(N+j)/cos(pi j/n)); sign cases exclude odd n>=7 congruent 3 mod 4, and among n congruent 1 mod 4 admit only 5,9. At n=9 the frequencies 3,6 vanish; there are no positive modes. Finite Schoenberg negative-type equivalence and strict PD of distinct-point Gaussian kernels prove the claimed universal t>0 statement, with converse small-t failure from positive distance eigenmodes. Independent FFT checks of all n=3..128 matched formulas and admissibility including zero modes at nine.
